headline: Over 40,000 units shipped: are factories ready to pay for "humanoid" robots?
summary: Shipments of humanoid robots have exceeded 40,000 units, but high full-unit prices and long industrial commissioning cycles keep costs high, according to an industry commentator.
why: Humanoid robots are an emerging automation technology, and their adoption depends on falling component costs and proven industrial returns.

original_headline: 出货已超4万台，工厂准备好为“人形”买单了吗？
